Conradus Grebelius,juvenis in utraq; lingua eruditissimus, patria Tigurinus, scripsit praefationem in Pomponium Melam, Paris.excusum cum Vadiani commentarijs, item epigrammata quaedam nondum excusa.

Conradus de Halberstat,natione Germanus,canonicus fratrum praedicatorum, scripsit Summam studentium lib.3. De triuio quoq; lib.1. Lectura in Job lib.1. Sermonum etiam lib.1. In plures quoq; Bibliorum libros commentarios scripsisse dicitur, qui tamen ad manus nostras adhuc minime venerunt. Hic etiam fertur concordantias totius noui & veteris Testamenti primus ordinasse.
Conradus Heingarter, Tigurinus,medicinae doctor, & Caroli VIII. Francorum regis physicus, scripsit Defensionem astronomiae,quae manuscripta extat Tiguri.

page.notes: Marginal numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 in the gutter are line-number markers, placed beside their lines. The right column's 10 to 60 markers could not all be placed with certainty, so they are omitted there. Long s is written as s. The left column's last word "Co" continues across the column break as "Coluthum". The hyphen after "A" in "Achillem" is a printed double hyphen. "veluti" at the top has an odd space in the scan. The Greek word "Ευαφισα" is uncertain and marked [?]. "Strobaei sententiasiite" is uncertain and marked [?]. The catchword "mos" completes "Boemos". Several long-s and ligature readings in the right column are uncertain and have not been marked individually.
